_comment: Read by `harness mcp <ls|invoke>` (metaharness/dist/mcp-cmd.js). This mirrors the REAL servers registered in the repo-root .mcp.json — do not add/remove servers here without updating .mcp.json too, and vice versa. Governance posture for these servers lives in .harness/mcp-policy.json, which is what `harness mcp-scan` actually reads.

mcpServers.name: claude-flow
mcpServers.description: Primary MCP server for this repo (see root .mcp.json). autoStart:false; env enables MCP_GROUP_SECURITY, MCP_GROUP_BROWSER, MCP_GROUP_NEURAL, MCP_GROUP_AGENTIC_FLOW, hierarchical-mesh topology, CLAUDE_FLOW_MAX_AGENTS=15, CLAUDE_FLOW_MEMORY_BACKEND=hybrid. Exposes 300+ tools (agent orchestration, memory/AgentDB, hooks, swarm coordination, browser automation, terminal execution, MetaHarness scans, GitHub, and more) — see the deferred-tool listing surfaced to agents in this session for the current set.

mcpServers.name: ruv-swarm
mcpServers.description: Optional swarm-coordination MCP server (root .mcp.json marks it optional:true). Exposes agent spawn/list/metrics, DAA (decentralized autonomous agent) tools, neural pattern training, and task orchestration.

mcpServers.name: flow-nexus
mcpServers.description: Optional cloud platform MCP server (root .mcp.json marks it optional:true, requiresAuth:true). Exposes E2B sandbox execution, cloud swarm/neural-training orchestration, storage, and payment/credit tools — the broadest network + shell + file-write surface of the three registered servers.
